description:
Failure is only expensive when it stops you.

If you can move from lesson to lesson, setback to setback, rejection to rejection… without losing your enthusiasm, you become impossible to beat.

Because while everyone else is busy protecting their ego, you’re building experience.

Speed matters.
Resilience matters.
Staying in the game matters most.

The faster you fail, the faster you learn.
The faster you learn, the faster you win.

Keep moving. Your success may be one more attempt away.
transcript: How fast can you fail? Winston Churchill said, and this is a quote I had on my desk for 15 years. The definition of success is going from failure to failure without losing your enthusiasm.
